people.name: Lynn Melfi
people.credentials: NCPT · Third-generation classical instructor · 15+ years teaching
bio: Lynn runs the studio in the spirit of Joe Pilates: individualized, intentional and deeply effective.
After years of watching what helped clients thrive, she built the Pilates Intelligence Program™ to give every client private-level attention.

people.name: Jen Ward
people.credentials: Classical Pilates Instructor · Licensed Acupuncturist · Ayurvedic Practitioner · Fletcher Practitioner · Pelvic Floor Specialist
bio: Jen has over two decades of experience in movement and wellness. Pilates resolved her own chronic nerve pain when nothing else could, and that shapes how she teaches: with compassion, precision and a whole-body perspective.
She specializes in supporting women through every stage of life, from fertility and perimenopause to stress recovery and beyond.
